projects.title: Development Automation Skill
projects.description: Engineered a stateful, multi agent AI framework that decomposes complex Low Level Designs into sequential subproblems. Orchestrated specialized AI personas across development stages, integrating automated design drift detection and human in the loop checkpoints to enforce strict architectural fidelity and high quality code.

projects.title: Notification Agent
projects.description: Architected an autonomous notification agent leveraging FastAPI and LangGraph for complex reasoning. Designed the system to fetch live news and reason over active enterprise campaign data (themes, categories, timelines) stored in a local PostgreSQL database, utilizing a local LLM via Ollama to generate context aware suggestions

projects.title: Bubble pop
projects.description: A computer vision based game where you are inside the game and pop virtual bubbles dropping on your screen using your hands to earn points.

projects.title: Identity Service
projects.description: Built a highly available Spring Boot service designed for containerized deployment to generate guaranteed unique IDs at scale. Useful for applications like tinyURL.

projects.title: Focus
projects.description: A browser extension that helps you stay focused by adding a timer barrier before you can access distracting websites during your work hours.
